build_ambiguous_candidate_identifier: build an AmbiguousCandidateIdentifier model with gpt2 or bert backbone for text-visual similarity scoring
create_ambiguous_candidate_identifier: create an AmbiguousCandidateIdentifier instance by passing a tokenizer and args dict with backbone, hidden_size, visual_feature_size, and use_gpu keys
run_forward_pass: run the forward method on a batch dict containing text_in tensors and visual features to get similarity logits
test_text_encoder: test the text_encoder attribute to access the underlying GPT-2 or BERT transformer for text embedding extraction
review_visual_fc_layer: review the visual_fc linear layer that projects visual features into the same hidden dimension as text embeddings
